sc: It is a possible reward from completing a medium clue scroll as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Heraldic armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be decorated by any players.
An animal doll is a Guthixian artefact that is made by restoring its damaged variant at an archaeologist's workbench.
The arcane pulse necklace is obtained as a reward from the Dungeoneering skill and requires 6,500 Dungeoneering tokens to purchase, and requires level 30 Magic and level 21 Dungeoneering to equip.
They can be created by combining 3,600 trapper fragments.
They could be obtained from the Elite Trapper Outfits Treasure Hunter promotion.
The Artisan's workshop flyer is a reward from the third Premier Club chest, first available on 13 November 2018.
The augmented crystal chakram is a one-handed ranged main hand weapon created by using an augmentor on a crystal chakram.
The balancing wand is an item that could be purchased from the Marketplace for 250 oddments before the rotating cosmetic stock update on 4 March 2024.
It was also previously available from the rare token store.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 10 bane bars and a bane platebody + 1, requiring 4,500 progress to complete, granting a total of 7,000 Smithing experience.

Battle Robes (Fumus) Footwear.x: Battle Robes (Fumus) Footwear is a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Battle Robes (Fumus) set.

sc: Blowpipe chitin is a rare drop from the certain dinosaur Slayer monsters of Anachronia.
Blurite 2h crossbows can be made through the Fletching skill at level 16; a player must first cut an oak stock for the crossbow from oak logs, granting 8 Fletching experience.
The botanist's top is an item obtainable as a reward from the Flash Powder Factory minigame.
It is given to the player by Valentina Kaust, who states it's fine quality blood given to her by a friend who smuggled it in from Canifis.
It is found on a pedestal inside some caves under Eagles' Peak mountain.
It is not possible to obtain it without setting off the trap.
Burnt meat is made by failing to cook raw scimitops meat, raw asciatops meat, or raw malletops meat.
A Carnivorous chinchompa (unchecked) can be obtained by hunting chinchompas in the Feldip Hunter area with box traps.
The Cave Wolf Matriarch skull is obtained by killing the Cave Wolf Matriarch after the Carnillean Rising quest.
To obtain the chest, a player must rub an enchanted key to find the location where the chest is buried, which is an area south of the Observatory and north of Castle Wars.

sc: The pet was made obtainable again in a hidden update prior to 27 June 2017, and can now be unlocked by entering the Legends' Guild.
The boost was not available to free players, but the lamps could still be obtained in free worlds.

Closure's hood.x: Closure's hood is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Closure's robes set.

sc: Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (medium) is a cryptic clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
It is made by using two soft clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 3 Crafting and giving 13 Crafting experience.
The Crafting crate (large) is an item that can be won from Squeal of Fortune which contains a variety of crafting materials; there is also a chance for an additional reward.
Dark Fire sword is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 750 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 39 of Count Yakula's Yak Track with the premier pass.

sc: Dark Phoenix is a companion pet that can be purchased for free from the Dark Phoenix Armoury once the Dark Phoenix Knight Armour, Dark Phoenix Knight Blade, and Dark Phoenix Knight Offhand Blade have all been unlocked.

During the Phoenix Showdown Treasure Hunter promotion from 25 July 2024 to 29 July 2024, players can find the Dark Phoenix near the Lumbridge and Varrock lodestones and pet it to obtain a free Dark Phoenix Sigil.
It is obtained by upgrading the tier 30 variant with two pieces of lesser ensouled cloth and one spool of lesser ensouled thread after the completion of Kili's Knowledge II.
It is dropped by Kal'gerion demons and by demon bosses as part of Demon Flash Mobs.

Dervish trousers (maroon).x: The maroon dervish trousers are part of the dervish outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

Disco top.x: The disco top is a reward for completing the fourth column of the list of resolutions once in the New Year's Resolutions Treasure Hunter promotion, or may be obtained from white balloons during the 300 Million Party.

sc: A entropic guard is a main-hand necromancy weapon available in Daemonheim.
It is exclusively dropped by Unholy cursebearer.

Extreme antisanguine flask.x: An extreme antisanguine flask is a potion flask containing six doses of extreme antisanguine. It is created by using extreme antisanguine potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: The Falador Park XP lamp is a possible reward from a supply cache in the Invasion of Falador event.

Fallen Nihil Chestpiece.x: The Fallen Nihil Chestpiece is the chest-slot override component of the Fallen Nihil outfit, awarded after handing in a total of 2,000 or more burning embers to the Fallen Nihil throughout the duration of the Birth by Fire event. It made its return on the Oddments Store, appearing on 29 May 2018, and has since been removed.

sc: The Fatesworn Agent cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 4 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 16 of Yak to the Shadows with the premier pass.

h: Via skilling, Rixie's shop, and the cosmetics stall
sc: A fish in a bag token is a token that could be obtained through the 2018 Spring Fayre.

tx: Despite there being two different shops, they share the same stock.

sc: Frogburgers are a Dorgeshuun cuisine that is made by the cave goblins.
Frogburgers can be purchased in the Dorgesh-Kaan marketplace from Durgok for 10 coins.

Furies Agent Horns is the head-slot override component of the Furies Agent outfit, awarded after handing in a total of 9,000 or more Zamorakian emblems to Miithrius and Zymthara throughout the duration of the Agents of Fury event.
The Ghostly Halo appearance token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that unlock the Ghostly pet during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 88 Smithing from four gorgonite bars.
Grand Exchange receipt is an item obtained in Meg's cases.
Once obtained, a player may take it to a Grand Exchange clerk, who will inform the player that the receipt is worth 104,273,167 coins and belongs to someone named "Adrian".
It's made by using a calquat keg with a finished barrel of ale after brewing greenman's ale.

Grimy rogue's purse is a herb that is obtained by searching the fungus covered Cavern walls in the Pothole Dungeon, as a drop from a jogre or wandering warrior, or from the smashed table in Mort'ton during the Shades of Mort'ton quest.
If the herb is dropped by a monster, Trufitus will complain that the herb isn't fresh and that players must find one themselves.
The Guthix halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from (or sold to) Lanthus for 300 gold Castle wars tickets.
Gypsum is a chemical that is obtained by searching cupboards during the Miss Cheevers part of the Recruitment Drive quest.
Hasty whirligig shells are obtained when hunting hasty whirligigs inside Het's Oasis.
The heka is an off-hand item found in the Het tomb accessible after the Our Man in the North quest.
They are found in the ice maker in the break room in the north-west of the secret bunker.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
Kebabs can be bought from Karim in western Al Kharid for 1 coin each.
It can be obtained by completing the Wise Am the Music Man collection.

sc: Large celebration lamp is a lamp that can be won on Treasure Hunter.
It can be found from the dead legionaries in the first room.

Lunar torso (green).x: The lunar torso is a piece of lunar equipment worn in the torso slot. It can be recoloured into a blue, red, or yellow torso or back to its original colour by using it on Diango after purchasing the Lunar Equipment (re-colour) service from Solomon's General Store for 2,000 Loyalty Points or by claiming the Loyalty Point Bundle from the Marketplace.

Lunarlight High Shaman Boots.x: The Lunarlight High Shaman Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Lunarlight Shaman Bundle.

sc: The head is obtained by combining the sapphire, emerald, and ruby golem head.

Manticore Off-hand Mace.x: Manticore Off-hand Mace is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Manticore Melee Weapon Pack.

sc: It was temporarily available from Treasure Hunter from 17 November 2020 to 23 November 2020 as part of the Dressed to Skill promotion.
The master quarrymaster aura is a tier 3 aura that can be bought from the Solomon's General Store for 33,500 Membership Loyalty Points.
The quarrymaster aura and greater quarrymaster aura must be owned before this can be purchased.

Meadweaver Bottoms.x: Meadweaver Bottoms is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Meadweaver Outfit. It is unlocked at 8,000 nectar during The Need for Mead event.

sc: A medium Hunter XP lamp is a reward for completing the Jed Hunter miniquest.
It can also be purchased from the Hunter mark shop for 25 hunter marks.
A medium XP lamp (Agility) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
It is created by clicking the Mix-cocktail option on a cocktail shaker, with a pineapple, lemon and orange in the inventory, requiring level 6 Cooking.

They were obtained from ghost implings within the maze and were used to create moonstone bone darts, a ranged weapon used to scare away zombies and skeletons within the maze, as well as dealing damage to boss at the centre of the maze.
Netty's key is a quest item obtained during the Vessel of the Harbinger quest by exchanging Netty's death certificate and will with a ghost banker in Port Phasmatys.
The off-hand argonite knife is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
Members can alternatively obtain the knives from the starting room table, or as a drop from the Necrolord, although these are not reliable methods of obtaining them.
It is a rare drop from Solak and has a special effect that gives a 25% chance to save ammunition.
To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 50 chompies, then talk to Rantz.

Overhead Emote: Sir Coalington Embarrass.x: The Overhead Emote: Sir Coalington Embarrassed is a reward from the 2024 Advent Calendar. It only appears in the calendar interface and isn't received as an item; the Sir Coalington Embarrassed overhead emote is unlocked directly upon claiming it.

Pharaoh's sandals (red, female).x: The red pharaoh's sandals is part of the pharaoh's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Multiple pens can be made.

Relicym's balm is a potion made by mixing a rogue's purse potion (unfinished) and a clean snake weed.
This potion can be made into a relicym's balm flask by using at least six doses of it with a potion flask.

Samba top (white).x: The white samba top is part of the samba outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Soul Reaver Robe Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 Rasial's sigils from Rasial's Vault shop.
It is created by combining an elemental impetus, a mystic mud staff, an earth talisman, and a water talisman.

The super large egg was special quest item that could be found in Fred the Farmer's chicken yard in Lumbridge, in the chicken coop at the Lumbridge Watermill, or by killing chickens during Cook's Assistant.

The Survivor's Journal, written by Irwinsson Siglison, is a book which can be found in a bag near the shipwreck on the western coast of Anachronia, alongside the broken compass and if destroyed after completing A New Direction it can be found in the bookcase of a player-owned house.
The team-13 cape is a wilderness cape that can be purchased for 50 coins from Larry.
It is found by searching the rubble in the north side of Kethsi.
The strange device will also be found at the same time.
The Risen Shadow Scream Staff is a two-handed magic weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing The Risen Pack.
A red Thieving tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.
The tribal tattoo is a cosmetic headgear that could only be obtained from playing the Squeal of Fortune.
It was once again made obtainable during the Blast from the Past II Treasure Hunter promotion on 17 July through 22 July 2014.
The Umbral Templar Outfit is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked through Prime Gaming as part of an offer between 19 April 2022 and 17 May 2022.
The unfinished decorations are items which the player can obtained from the crate of unfinished decorations in Christmas Village.
Unidentified spices can be found in a supply cupboard in the Kitchen during Murder on the Border.
